geometryBasis: The named native tower envelope fixes the center and footprint. The preserve’s record supplies a 29m base diameter and 96.52m total height. The 29-vertex mapped circle is reconstructed as the eight-sided tower visible in the cleared photograph.
sectionBasis: The July 2013 whole-tower image establishes the ochre base, solid lower colonnade, two open upper colonnades, heavy terraces and gilded dome. The detail image supplies the eagle capitals. Stage heights and off-camera details are photo estimates.
